transcription.testTitle: Meetings 2: the role of the chairperson

exercises.instruction: Choose the best word to fill each gap from the alternatives given below. Put a circle around the letter, A, B or C, of the word you choose.
items: My name is Stuart Macintosh and I am personal assistant to the CEO of Eastern Oil. He is the (1) ............ of the company's finance committee. I'm responsible for arranging the monthly meetings. I have to prepare the (2) ............ and then I have to (3) ............ it to all the participants. I also have to send copies of the (4) ............ of the last meeting. It's my job to check the (5) ............ , to make sure that the meeting room is suitable and that lunch has been ordered. You have to be a good (6) ............ to do a job like this.
1 A chairlady    B chairperson    C chairwoman
2 A diary        B calendar       C agenda
3 A circulate    B circular       C circle
4 A hours        B minutes        C seconds
5 A avenue       B revenue        C venue
6 A organizer    B organized      C organization

exercises.instruction: The statements below were made at a meeting. Write one word in the gap to complete each statement.
items: 1 'Juliet, will you t.................. the minutes today?'
2 'Does everyone agree that the minutes are an accurate r.................. of the last meeting?'
3 'Are there any m.................. arising?'
4 'In the a.............. points it says Bob is responsible for writing the report. Is that right?'
5 'Now, we have a................ 30 minutes to the discussion of point 1, so let's get started.'
6 'I want to make the p.................. that we are still two people short in the office.'
7 'We haven't t.................. this issue so we'll discuss it next week and make a decision then.'
8 'Let's m.................. on to the next point or we won't finish on time.'

exercises.instruction: Find a word related to each clue. The first and last letters of the answers are given.
items: 1 List of the things to be discussed at a meeting
2 Keep to this or the meeting will finish late
3 How the Chair should deal with disagreements
4 Someone who gets to the meeting after it has started
5 When someone goes off the point in a discussion
